paragraphs: Runs machinekind/Matcha-TTS-PL entirely in the browser: the ONNX graph of the chosen voice (acoustic model + its own HiFi-GAN) via ONNX Runtime Web (WebGPU, WebAssembly fallback), phonemization via an espeak-ng WebAssembly build (Polish, and English for detected English words), the effects chain in JavaScript. Nothing is sent to a server; each voice's model (≈140 MB) is downloaded when you pick it and cached by the browser.

Four synthetic voices (malevoxcpm1, femalevoxcpm1, malevoxcpm2, femalevoxcpm2, designed with VoxCPM2 — not real people), trained on the polish-synthetic-speech-voxcpm2 dataset. Model weights CC BY-SA 4.0 (see the model card and ATTRIBUTION.md there); playground code MIT; espeak-ng GPL-3.0. Pretraining checkpoint (audiobook readers, not intended for production): spaces/machinekind/matcha-tts-pl-pretrain.
